title: 0015 弄巧成拙0016 前途未卜
content_zh:
“哎呀呀，打人啦……周豹打人啦……我和你们拼了！”和周豹相比洪涛的声音更大，已经达到凄厉程度了，生怕别人听不见。
“走你吧……”然后突然上步侧身，从对方双手上面横肘猛推咽喉，右腿先迈步又向后踢钩别住对方小腿，来了个利落的大外刈，将周豹结结实实的摔在了地上。
“好你个绝户穷厮，敢动俺兄弟，找打！”
不管周家兄弟人品如何，之间的感情还是很牢固的，遇到事儿总是一起上。此时周虎见到弟弟被摔倒，热血立刻充满了脑袋，啥规矩不规矩的全忘了，一个恶狗扑食就窜了上来。
“咚……啪嚓……”然而迎接他的不是身体，而是大脚丫子。洪涛早就算到了结果，在周豹倒地的瞬间头也没回，左腿直接后蹬了出去，正好踹在周虎的胸腹之间。
“绝户贼休走……哥，打他头！”然而周家兄弟也不是白给，本来就身强体壮，现在二对一，虽然一上来就分别吃了闷亏，可反应还是很快的。
先是周豹忍着身体上的疼痛合身抱住了洪涛的腿，而后周虎把吐到嘴边的晚饭也咽了回去，再次扑了过来。
“直娘贼……绝户贼……遭瘟的……贼王八……”既然是互殴，洪涛就不能单方面占便宜，必须有来有回。然后三个人就滚到了一起，大拳头上下翻飞，叫骂声响彻后院。
此时公廨这两排房间已经不再静悄悄了，凡是没当值的力士和杂役全都被吵醒，纷纷跑出来看热闹，然后就是议论纷纷。
“王哥，洪涛怎么和周家兄弟打在一起了？”
“嗨，早晚的事儿，老实人被逼急了更狠！”
“好家伙，不看不知道啊，洪涛这拳脚够力道……哎呦呦，见血了、见血了！”
“周虎，你白长了偌大的身子，怎么这么笨，照脸上打啊！”
但所有人都只是围观评论外加拱火，一个上来拉架的都没有。这倒不是他们的心全都黑了，而是怕被误认为参加斗殴到时候说不清。
这里的公廨和诏狱其实在一座大院子里，监管力度非常高，不光四周矗立着好几座高塔，全天有军卒在上面拿着劲弩瞭望，院子里还有两三队卫士巡视，几乎无死角，随时能应对各种变故。
“嗖……当当当……”也就是几分钟的功夫，高塔上传来了响箭和铜锣声，然后就是一队队顶盔掼甲手持刀枪弓弩的卫士迅速向事发地包围，连房顶上也出现了若干身影。
“贼配军，不好好睡觉却要殴斗，来人，将他们都绑了！”
最先赶到的卫士校尉看到是三名力士互殴，立马怒火中烧，问也不问，催马上来照着正压在洪涛身上挥拳的周虎后背就是一刀鞘，直接把人抽成了滚地葫芦，而后才下令抓人。
“尔等速速回屋，休要聒噪！”
玄鸟卫至少都是八品的修士，一人一个抓起打架的三人和抓小鸡子似的，再从腰上拿下绳索，抹肩头笼二臂捆了结实，拽着就走。

出了公廨的院子还有个大院子，门楣上挂着匾额，上面却只有一个西字，纯黑色。这里就是镇妖殿三殿之一的西殿，专职管理诏狱，也是掌印和典狱官的办公地点。
北边同样有个大院子，匾额上有个绿色的北字。北殿属于行政和后勤部门，下辖各种库房，包括公廨和厨房也归其管理。
南边的大院子自然是南殿，而且占地面积最大，其中三分之一都是马厩。南殿在镇妖殿体系中算核心中的核心，工作内容庞杂，主掌侦缉、抓捕，且面向全国范围，人员众多。
有没有东殿呢？没有，镇妖殿的东边是大门，出去就是广场和街道了，根本没有建筑物。实际上弄个东殿也没啥用，南北西三个部门足够用，太五脏俱全万事不求人反而不美，容易惹来猜忌。
此时正值早餐过后主官换值的当口，各院门口人员进进出出络绎不绝，见到玄鸟卫绑了3名力士从诏狱院子里出来纷纷驻足侧目。毕竟敢在京城镇妖殿中犯事的内部员工不很常见，准确的说已经很多年未见了。
“停下，尔等为何事抓捕力士？”更凑巧的是正有一队玄鸟卫伴着一辆马车从大门进入，见到此景立刻有一骑上前盘问。
“嘿嘿嘿，今天你们三有好日子过了，落在鲁王殿下手里后半年还能不能起来床就看命硬不硬了。好好的日子不过非要殴斗，还在殿内殴斗，是不是活腻了？”
见到这队人马，主要是那辆马车，揪着周虎绳头的卫士一边单膝下跪行礼一边嘟囔。声音虽小，洪涛却听了个真真切切，然后心里一片哇凉。
他只是想借闹事弄个革除，不想再被看押，才故意挑了个掌印和典狱官在的时间段殴斗。谁承想鲁王殿下又来了，这不是倒霉催的嘛。
镇妖殿归鲁王管辖，自然有诸多传闻，其中九成都与一件事相关，严于律己也严于律人。据说这皇帝长子为人本本分分兢兢业业，但由于生母过世较早失去了助力，在四个皇子之中当太子的呼声却最低。
落到这种性格的人手里，大概率会执行惩罚的上限。如果真那样的话，先打一百军棍平平常常。结果自然和卫士预计的差不多，轻则几个月起不来床，直接打残打死也不算太稀奇。
“而等为何殴斗？”
在洪涛一顿祈祷下，鲁王还是亲自过问此事了，而且就在三个院落之间的广场上，身后站着一堆镇妖殿高官，既有西殿掌印也有南殿和北殿的，即便有人想大事化小小事化了现在也没机会了。
“是周家兄弟欺人太甚！昨日本不该小人当值，是他们将小人骗了去，结果昨晚回城不及又在街亭镇住了一夜，凭白花了几十文。我去讨要他们非但不给还要我滚，否则就给点颜色。小人气不过骂了两句，他们又先动手！”
事已至此，缩脖子是一刀伸脖子还是一刀，洪涛只能在渺茫的希望中争取利益最大化。赶紧抢答，把打架的原因说清楚也是借机提醒鲁王，我可是帮您去东郊送信的，没功劳也有苦劳吧。
“嗯，孤记得你，可曾见到胡城隍了？”这番表述好像起作用了，鲁王盯着洪涛看了几眼，阴沉的脸色稍有缓解，还主动把话题岔开了。
“回禀殿下，卑职见到胡城隍了。”洪涛赶紧顺杆爬，而且故意不提送诗句的事儿。
“好，你确实都忘掉了，很好。孤是让典狱陪同，你又为何当天不能返回？”
鲁王很上道，满意地点了点头，但马上话锋一转又问起了中途赶路的时间。如果有马代步，从东郊回城很快，根本用不着在街亭镇留宿，也就不存在回来找周家兄弟赔偿了。
此时鲁王在洪涛心目中已经不仅仅是作风严谨了，还得加上个心思缜密，深谙审讯技巧。他这么东一榔头西一棒子的问话，并不是被谁的话题带偏了，而是有意为之，用来搅乱受审者的思绪，更容易找到漏洞。

“……小人以为殿下只吩咐送到城隍庙，就让典狱官返回了。可小人没怎么出过远门，忘了回来那么远。”
这一招对普通人很管用，但洪涛可是经历过后世无数次警察关照的派出所常客，回答起来一点难度都没有，还故意为典狱官扛了一把。
可眼神却不由自主的瞟向那边，不光充满了既反动又怕死的小市民风格，还带着点憨态。
content_en:
"Oops, he's beating someone... Zhou Bao is beating someone... I'll fight with you!" Hong Tao's voice was louder than Zhou Bao's, it had reached a level of shrillness, for fear that others wouldn't hear.
"Let's go..." Then he suddenly stepped forward and turned sideways, thrust his elbow across the opponent's hands into the throat, stepped forward with his right leg and then kicked back to pin the opponent's calf. He then made a neat big kick, slamming Zhou Bao to the ground.
"You are a poor poor man. If you dare to touch my brother, I will fight you!"
No matter what their personalities are, the relationship between the Zhou brothers is still very strong, and they always work together when encountering problems. At this time, Zhou Hu saw his younger brother being thrown down, and his blood immediately filled his head. He forgot all the rules and regulations, and a vicious dog rushed up to attack him.
"Boom... crack..." However, what greeted him was not his body, but his big feet. Hong Tao had already calculated the result. When Zhou Bao fell to the ground, he didn't even look back. He kicked his left leg directly back and kicked Zhou Hu in the chest and abdomen.
"Don't let the thief go away...Brother, hit him on the head!" However, the Zhou brothers were not in vain. They were already strong, and now they were two against one. Although they suffered a heavy loss from the beginning, they still reacted very quickly.
First, Zhou Bao endured the pain in his body and hugged Hong Tao's leg, and then Zhou Hu swallowed back the dinner he spat into his mouth and pounced on him again.
"Straight wife thieves... destitute thieves... plagued thieves... thieves and thieves..." Since they were fighting each other, Hong Tao couldn't take advantage of each other unilaterally, there had to be back and forth. Then the three people rolled together, their fists flying up and down, and their shouts and curses echoed throughout the backyard.
At this time, the two rows of rooms in the public house were no longer quiet. All the warriors and servants who were not on duty were woken up and ran out to watch the fun, and then started talking about it.
"Brother Wang, how come Hong Tao is fighting with the Zhou brothers?"
"Hey, it's only a matter of time. An honest man will be forced to be more aggressive!"
"Good guy, you don't know it until you see it. Hong Tao's punches and kicks are so powerful... Ouch, there's blood, there's blood!"
"Zhou Hu, you've grown so big for nothing, why are you so stupid, you slap me in the face!"
But everyone just watched and commented, and no one came forward to start a fight. This is not because they are all dark-hearted, but because they are afraid that they will be mistaken for participating in a fight.
The public house and prison here are actually in a large courtyard, and the supervision is very high. Not only are there several high towers standing around, and there are soldiers on top holding crossbows all day long, there are also two or three teams of guards patrolling the courtyard. There are almost no blind spots, and they can respond to various changes at any time.
"Whoosh...dang...dang..." Within a few minutes, the sound of arrows and gongs came from the tower, and then groups of guards with helmets and armors holding swords, guns and crossbows quickly surrounded the place where the incident occurred, and even several figures appeared on the roof.
"Thieves join the army. They don't sleep well but they fight. Come here and tie them all up!"
The captain of the guard who arrived first saw three warriors fighting each other. He immediately became furious. Without asking, he rushed over and hit Zhou Hu who was punching Hong Tao with a scabbard on his back. He whipped the person into a rolling gourd before ordering his arrest.
"Please go back to the house quickly and stop making any noise!"
The Black Bird Guards were all at least eighth-grade monks. One by one, they grabbed the three fighting men like chickens, then took the rope from their waists, tied their arms tightly with their shoulders, and dragged them away.
There is a large courtyard beyond Gongse's courtyard. There is a plaque hanging on the lintel, but there is only one word "西" on it, which is pure black. This is the West Hall, one of the three halls of the Demon Suppressing Hall, which is dedicated to the management of the imperial prison. It is also the office location of the palm seal and the warden.
There is also a large courtyard to the north, and there is a green character "North" on the plaque. The North Hall belongs to the administrative and logistics department, and has various warehouses under its jurisdiction, including the public hall and the kitchen.
The large courtyard in the south is naturally the South Hall, and it occupies the largest area, with one-third of itThey are all stables. The South Palace is the core among the cores in the Demon Suppression Palace system. Its work content is complex, and it is responsible for investigation and arrest. It is nationwide and has a large number of personnel.
Is there an east hall? No, there is a gate to the east of the Demon Suppression Hall, and there are squares and streets outside. There are no buildings at all. In fact, it is useless to have an east hall. The three departments of north, south and west are enough. If it is too well-equipped and does not ask for anything, it will not be beautiful, and it will easily arouse suspicion.
At this time, when the chief officer was changing after breakfast, there was a constant stream of people coming in and out of the gates of each courtyard. When they saw the Xuantiao guards tied up three strong men coming out of the prison yard, they all stopped and looked sideways. After all, internal employees who dare to commit crimes in the Demon Palace in Beijing Town are not very common. To be precise, they have not been seen for many years.
"Stop, why are you arresting the powerful man?" What happened was that a team of black bird guards accompanied a carriage entering through the gate. Seeing this, a horseman immediately stepped forward to question him.
"Hehehehe, the three of you have had a good time today. Whether you can get out of bed for half a year after falling into the hands of His Highness King Lu depends on your fate. A good life only requires fighting, and fighting in the palace. Are you tired of living?"
Seeing this group of people, mainly the carriage, the guard holding Zhou Hu's rope knelt down on one knee and muttered in salute. Although the voice was small, Hong Tao heard it very clearly, and then his heart felt cold.
He just wanted to use the trouble to get expelled and didn't want to be detained again, so he deliberately picked a time period when the palm prints and the warden were around. Who would have thought that His Highness King Lu is here again? Isn't this just bad luck?
The Demon Suppression Hall is under the jurisdiction of King Lu, so naturally there are many rumors, 90% of which are related to one thing, strict self-discipline and strict disciplining of others. It is said that the eldest son of the emperor was dedicated to his duties as a human being, but because his biological mother passed away early and lost his support, he was the least popular among the four princes to be crown prince.
If it falls into the hands of a person with this kind of personality, there is a high probability that the maximum punishment will be imposed. If that's the case, it's normal to hit a hundred army sticks first. The result was naturally similar to what the guards had expected. It would not be too unusual for him to be unable to get out of bed for several months, or to be directly maimed and beaten to death.
"And why are you fighting?"
After Hong Tao prayed, King Lu personally intervened in the matter, and in the square between the three courtyards, behind him stood a group of senior officials of the Demon Suppression Palace, including those from the West Palace, the South Palace, and the North Palace. Even if some people wanted to turn a big deal into a trivial matter, they had no chance now.
"It's the Zhou brothers who went too far! Yesterday, I shouldn't have been on duty, but they deceived the villain. As a result, I stayed overnight in a street pavilion before returning to the city last night, and spent dozens of coins for nothing. I went to beg them and they not only refused to give me, but also asked me to leave, otherwise they would give me some trouble. The villain was angry, but after a few curses, they took action again!"
At this point, whether shrinking one's neck or extending one's neck, Hong Tao can only strive to maximize his interests in the slim hope. Hurry up and answer. Explaining the reason for the fight clearly is also an opportunity to remind King Lu that I am helping you deliver a message to the eastern suburbs. No credit but hard work.
"Well, I remember you, have you ever met Hu Chenghuang?" This statement seemed to work. King Lu stared at Hong Tao for a few times, his gloomy expression eased slightly, and he took the initiative to change the subject.
"Reporting to Your Highness, I have humbled myself to meet Hu Chenghuang." Hong Tao hurriedly climbed up the pole and deliberately did not mention the poem.
"Okay, you have indeed forgotten everything, that's good. I asked the warden to accompany you, so why can't you return that day?"
King Lu was very sensible and nodded with satisfaction, but the conversation immediately changed and he asked about the time on the way. If he had a horse to travel with, he could return to the city from the eastern suburbs very quickly, and there would be no need to stay overnight in Jieting Town, and there would be no need to come back to seek compensation from the Zhou brothers.
At this time, in Hong Tao's mind, King Lu was not only rigorous in style, but also thoughtful and well versed in interrogation techniques. He was asking questions like this with a hammer and a stick. It wasn't because he was distracted by someone's topic., but it is done intentionally to confuse the subject's thoughts and make it easier to find loopholes.
"...The villain thought that His Highness only ordered the prisoner to be sent to the City God's Temple and then sent the warden back. But the villain has never been far away and forgot to come back so far."
This trick is very effective for ordinary people, but Hong Tao is a regular at the police station who has experienced countless police cares in later generations. It is not difficult at all to answer, and he deliberately shouldered the burden for the warden.
But his eyes couldn't help but glance over there, not only full of the reactionary and death-fearing philistine style, but also a little naive.
